blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now process hour-long videos, making extended multi-turn dialogue over a single video a natural mode of use. Sustaining such a dialogue requires more than answering each question in isolation: the model must retrieve and reuse information established earlier in the conversation, both what it has seen and what it has said, an ability we term in-context video memory. Existing video QA benchmarks leave this ability unmeasured: their questions are mutually independent, never reference one another, and each is answerable from the video alone, so nothing ever requires carrying information across turns. We introduce VideoMemBench, in which each sample pairs a single video with a long multi-turn dialogue, whose turns are connected by typed cross-turn dependencies: an Episodic Dependency refers back to a visual episode described in an earlier turn, probing memory of what the model has seen, while an Answer Dependency builds on the model's own earlier answer, probing memory of what the model has said. Every dependency is verified considering two properties: 1) necessity, meaning the question cannot be answered without its earlier turns, and 2) non-leakage, meaning the question does not restate the information from its earlier turns. To enforce these properties, we design a construction pipeline with three LLM roles: a planner, a generator, and a judger, with each dialogue reviewed by human experts. VideoMemBench comprises 326 videos with 2,476 turns, of which 1,387 depend on earlier turns, including multi-parent dependencies and long-range call-back. Among over 20 evaluated open- and closed-source MLLMs, Claude Opus 5 performs the best with an overall score of only 45.7\%, highlighting the challenge of in-context video memory. Our dataset and evaluation are released.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)现在可以处理长达小时的视频,使单个视频上的扩展多回合对话成为自然的使用模式. 维持这种对话不仅需要孤立地回答每个问题:模型必须检索和再利用对话中早些时候建立的信息,无论是它所看到的信息还是它所说的话,我们称之为内文视频记忆的能力。 现有的视频QA基准使得这种能力没有被衡量:他们的问题是相互独立的,从不相互参照,每个问题都可以从视频中单独回答,因此没有任何东西需要将信息带过转弯. 我们引入了VideoMem Bench,其中每个样本将单个视频配对并带有长多回合对话,其转折由打入的交叉回合依赖关系连接: 一个Episodic依赖关系是指在更早的转折中描述的一出视觉剧集,探究模型所见所闻的内存,而一个Answer依赖关系则建立在模型自己更早的答案上,探究模型所言的内存. 考虑到两个属性,每个依赖都得到核实: 1)危急情况,指问题若没有早先的转折就无法解答;2)非漏损,指问题不重复早先转折中的信息. 为了强制执行这些地产,我们设计了一条建筑管道,它有三个LLM的作用:一个规划员,一个发电机,一个法官,每个对话都由人类专家审查. VideoMem Bench由326个有2,476个转弯的视频组成,其中1,387个转弯依赖于更早的转弯,包括多父母依赖和远程回调. 在超过20个被评价的开源和闭源MLLMs中,克洛德·奥普斯5成绩最好,总得分只有45.7分,凸显了内文视频内存的挑战. 我们的数据集和评价已经发布。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) ( Comanici et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Anthropic, 2026a ) can now process hour-long videos, with million-token contexts that accommodate an entire film, a full match, or a day-long recording.
Building on this capability, extended multi-turn dialogue over a single long video is emerging as a natural mode of use: the model accompanies a user through the video with a stream of follow-up questions about its characters, events, and details.
Sustaining such a conversation raises a key question: when consecutive questions concern the same video, can the model correctly retrieve and reuse what the dialogue has already established? We refer to this ability as in-context video memory .
blocks.zh:
边疆多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)(Comanici等,2025;Singh等,2025;Team等,2026;Yang等,2025a;Anthropic,2026a)现在可以处理长达小时的视频,有百万个托肯背景,可以容纳一整部电影,完全匹配,或者一天的录音.
在这个能力的基础上,一个单长视频的扩展多回合对话正在成为一种自然的使用模式:该模型通过视频伴随一个用户,并有一系列有关其人物,事件和细节的后续问题.
保持这种对话提出了一个关键问题:当连续的问题涉及同一个视频时,模型能否正确检索和再利用对话已经建立的内容? 我们把这种能力称为内幕视频记忆。

blocks.en:
Recently, in-context memory has been systematically evaluated for large language models (LLMs) in text-only settings ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Kuratov et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Huet et al., 2025 ) .
However, extending this evaluation to video poses a key challenge: distinguishing questions that genuinely depend on prior dialogue context from those answerable using only the video and the current question.
Existing video understanding benchmarks ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Mangalam et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) are structurally unable to evaluate it.
Typically, they decompose the QA evaluation into mutually independent questions: no question references the content or answer of another, so nothing ever needs to be carried across turns, and every question is answerable from the video alone.
In other words, their dialogue histories are never load-bearing.
blocks.zh:
最近,对文本专用环境中的大型语言模型(LLM)进行了系统评价(Maharana等,2024;Hsieh等,2024;Kuratov等,2024;Tan等,2025;Wu等,2025;Huet等,2025)。
然而,将这一评价扩大到视频是一项关键的挑战:区分真正取决于先前对话背景的问题和仅使用视频和当前问题的回答问题。
现有的视频理解基准(Fu等,2025;Li等,2024;Mangalam等,2023;Wu等,2024;Wang等,2025;Fu等,2026)在结构上无法评估.
通常,它们将质量保证评价分解为相互独立的问题:没有问题提到另一个问题的内容或答案,所以没有任何问题需要经过转折,每个问题都只能从视频中回答.
换句话说,他们的对话历史从来不是充满的。

blocks.en:
To this end, we introduce VideoMemBench .
Each sample pairs a single video with a long multi-turn dialogue whose turns are connected by explicit, typed cross-turn dependencies, so that a sample is not a concatenation of separate questions but a memory chain running through the entire conversation.
The key design is that answering a dependent turn should require the dialogue and the video jointly: the dialogue supplies what an earlier turn established, and the video supplies the visual facts to ground the current one, so that neither source alone suffices.
Specifically, we design two dependency types, enforcing two forms of memory: Episodic Dependency , for recalling previously discussed visual episodes, and Answer Dependency , for recalling the model’s own earlier responses.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们介绍VideoMem Bench。
每个样片配对一个有长多回转对话的单个视频,其转弯由明确,打字的交叉回转依赖连接,这样一个样片就不是单个问题的集合而是一个贯穿整个对话的内存链.
关键的设计是,回答一个依赖的转折,应该要求对话和视频共同进行:对话提供早先确定的转折,视频提供视觉事实来打倒当前转折,这样两个来源都不足以解决问题。
具体地说,我们设计了两种依赖类型,执行两种形式的内存:Episodic依赖性,用于回顾先前讨论过的视觉事件;Answer依赖性,用于回顾模型自己先前的反应。

blocks.en:
(1) Episodic Dependency arises when a question depends on the visual episode that an earlier turn described: only by recalling that referent from the dialogue can the model determine what is being asked.
As shown in Figure 1 , T 1 T_{1} asks about the suspect mugshot pinned to the briefing-room corkboard, and T 2 T_{2} then asks whether the hippo officers are present in “the scene from T 1 T_{1} ” and what their names are, without restating where that scene is.
Unless the model retains that T 1 T_{1} was about the briefing room, it cannot tell which part of the video “the scene from T 1 T_{1} ” refers to, let alone check who is in it.
Episodic dependencies thus hinge on memory of what the model has seen .

(2) Answer Dependency arises when a question builds on the answer the model itself gave at an earlier turn: the model must continue from its own earlier response.
As shown in Figure 1 , T 1 T_{1} establishes that the suspect is an anteater, T 3 T_{3} then asks whether the animal that fox and rabbit meet at the shipping-container yard is “the target from T 1 T_{1} ”, which cannot be decided without the answer given at T 1 T_{1} . T 4 T_{4} in turn asks what happens next to “the animal met in T 3 T_{3} ”, building on the answer to T 3 T_{3} .
Answering thus demands two abilities at once: retrieval , locating the earlier answer within the accumulated dialogue, and consistency , keeping the current answer faithful to it rather than silently re-judging the video.
Answer dependencies thus hinge on memory of what the model has said .

因此,答案的依赖性取决于模型所说的记忆。

blocks.en:
These structurally diverse dependencies ensure that answering questions from our VideoMemBench requires the model to exercise in-context video memory throughout the dialogue.
We further verify every dependent turn for necessity and non-leakage : the question must be unanswerable without its parent turns, and must not restate the information they established before.
In total, VideoMemBench comprises 326 videos, each paired with a human-reviewed dialogue, totaling 2,476 turns, of which 1,387 depend on earlier turns.
Videos are drawn from five existing benchmarks and the web, covering 31 semantic domains across four categories (lifestyle & entertainment, knowledge & education, art & literature, sports & competition), and last up to 23.47 hours each.
The comparison in Table 1 shows that single-turn benchmarks evaluate questions independently, whereas multi-turn benchmarks extend evaluation to dialogues. VideoMemBench further provides explicit dependency graphs with typed edges and multiple parents, enabling structured evaluation of in-context video memory.
blocks.zh:
这些结构多样的依赖性确保了回答来自我们VideoMem Bench的问题需要这个模型在整个对话中锻炼出内在的视频内存.
我们进一步核实每个依赖性转折的必要性和非漏出性:问题必须在父母不转折的情况下无法回答,并且不得重复他们以前确定的信息。
VideoMem Bench总共由326个视频组成,每个视频都配有由人审查的对话,共2,476个转弯,其中1,387个转弯依赖于更早的转弯.
视频取自现有5个基准和网络,涵盖31个语义领域,分为4个类别(生活方式和娱乐、知识和教育、艺术和文学、体育和竞赛),每类最长可达23.47小时。
表1的比较表明,单回合基准独立评估问题,而多回合基准则将评价扩大到对话。 VideoMem Bench进一步提供了带有打出边缘和多父母的清晰的依赖性图表,从而能够对内文本视频内存进行有条理的评价.

blocks.en:
Evaluating over 20 representative open- and closed-source MLLMs on VideoMemBench, we find that current models clearly struggle with cross-turn dependencies: the best model we tested ( Claude Opus 5 ) achieves an overall score of only 45.7%, with 35.7% on answer-dependent turns and 49.1% on episodic-dependent turns, both below 53.9% on independent turns.
These results indicate that in-context video memory remains an open problem for current MLLMs.
blocks.zh:
在VideoMem Bench上评价超过20个具有代表性的开源和闭源MLLM, 我们发现目前的模型显然与交叉转折的依赖性相搏:我们测试的最佳模型(Claude Opus 5 ) 的总得分只有45.7%, 其中35.7%的答案依赖转折和49.1%的零星依赖转折均低于53.9%的独立转折.
这些结果表明,对当前MLLMs来说,内置视频内存仍然是一个开放的问题.

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We study in-context video memory , the ability of a model to retrieve and reuse what earlier turns have established in a consecutive video QA dialogue, which existing benchmarks leave unmeasured. • We build VideoMemBench , in which each sample is a long multi-turn dialogue grounded in a single video, with turns connected by typed cross-turn Episodic and Answer dependencies.
VideoMemBench comprises 326 video dialogues, totaling 2,476 turns with 1,387 dependent, verified for necessity and non-leakage, and reviewed by human experts. • We conduct extensive evaluations of over 20 open- and closed-source MLLMs on VideoMemBench. The best model achieves only 45.7% overall, with performance declining as dependency complexity increases, indicating that in-context video memory remains challenging for current MLLMs.
blocks.zh:

• 视频Mem Bench包括326个视频对话,共2 476个转弯,1 387个依附者,经核实为必要和非漏出,并由人类专家审查。 我们在视频Mem Bench上对20多个公开和非公开的MLLMs进行了广泛的评价。 最佳模式总体只实现45.7%,随着依赖性复杂性的增加,性能会下降,这表明对目前的MLLMs来说,内文视频内存仍然具有挑战性.

blocks.en: Related Works
blocks.zh: 相关作品

blocks.en:
Video Understanding Benchmarks. Existing video understanding benchmarks usually focus on temporal perception and reasoning.
MVBench ( Li et al., 2024 ) and TempCompass ( Liu et al., 2024a ) evaluate temporal understanding, while EgoSchema ( Mangalam et al., 2023 ) targets long-form video QA.
Broadening the scope, Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) covers diverse video durations and tasks, and Video-MMMU ( Hu et al., 2026 ) evaluates knowledge acquisition from multidisciplinary videos.
For longer contexts, LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025 ) focus on long-video understanding, while EgoLife ( Yang et al., 2025d ) examines egocentric experiences spanning hours and days.
Beyond temporal understanding, VSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025c ) evaluates video-based spatial reasoning.
Despite this growing coverage and temporal range, these benchmarks evaluate questions independently, without requiring information established in the earlier dialogue.
blocks.zh:
视频理解基准. 现有的视频理解基准通常侧重于时间感知和推理.
MV Bench (Li等,2024年)和TempCompass (Liu等,2024年a)评价时间理解,而EgoSchema (Mangalam等,2023年)的目标是长式视频QA.
拓宽范围,Video-MME(Fu等,2025年)涵盖不同视频持续时间和任务,Video-MMMU(Hu等,2026年)评价从多学科视频获取知识.
对于较长的情节,LongVideo Bench(Wu等,2024年)和LV Bench(Wang等,2025年)注重于长视理解,而EgoLife(Yang等,2025年d)则研究了跨越时日的自我中心体验.
超越时间理解,VSI-Bench(Yang等,2025c)评价了基于视频的空间推理.
尽管覆盖面和时间范围都在扩大,这些基准仍独立地评估问题,而不需要先前对话中确立的信息。

blocks.en:
Memory and Multi-Turn Evaluation. Existing benchmarks evaluate conversational memory and multi-turn interaction from several perspectives.
LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) and LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) assess long-term conversational memory, while MemBench ( Tan et al., 2025 ) distinguishes factual and reflective memory.
MT-Bench ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) evaluates two-turn response quality.
In multimodal settings, MMDU ( Liu et al., 2024b ) evaluates multi-turn, multi-image conversations, and MMRC ( Xue et al., 2025 ) includes multi-turn image reasoning and memory recall, but neither targets dialogue memory grounded in a single video.
VideoMemBench addresses this gap through explicit episodic and answer dependencies that link later questions to previously discussed video scenes and generated answers, with support for multiple parents and long-range connections.
blocks.zh:
记忆与多轮评价. 现有基准从几个角度评价对话记忆和多回合互动。
LoCoMo (Maharana等,2024年)和LongMemEval (Wu等,2025年)评估了长期的对话记忆,而Mem Bench (Tan等,2025年)则区分了事实记忆和反思记忆.
MT-Bench (Zheng等,2023年)评价了双转反应质量.
在多模式设置中,MMDU(Liu等,2024b)评价多回合,多图像对话,而MMRC(Xue等,2025年)则包括多回合图像推理和记忆回想,但两者都不针对基于单一视频的对话记忆.
VideoMem Bench通过明确的偶联和解答依赖,将后期问题与之前讨论的视频场景联系起来并产生答案来弥补这一差距,同时支持多父母和远程连接.

Each VideoMemBench sample pairs a video with a multi-turn dialogue, annotated with reference answers and a typed dependency graph.
Each edge links a dependent turn to a parent turn and is labeled as Episodic or Answer.
Below, we describe the requirements for valid dependencies and visually grounded answers, followed by the construction pipeline and dataset statistics.

每个VideoMem Bench样本配对一个带有多回合对话框的视频,附加了参考答案和打入的依赖性图表的说明.
每个边缘将一个依赖的转折连接到父转折,并被标记为Episodic或Answer.
下面我们介绍对有效依赖的要求和有目视依据的答案,然后是建筑管道和数据集统计。

blocks.en: Design Requirements
blocks.zh: 设计要求

blocks.en:
Constructing valid dependencies requires going beyond ‘simple references to earlier turns.
The key challenge lies in ensuring that cross-turn dependencies are genuinely necessary, do not leak prior information, and remain grounded in the video.
This leads to three requirements:
blocks.zh:
构建有效的依赖性需要超越`简单参考先前的转折'。
关键的挑战在于确保交叉依赖性是真正必要的,不泄露先前的信息,并始终以视频为基础。
这就产生了三项要求:

blocks.en:
Req-1: Dependency Necessity. A dependent question must become unanswerable when its parent turns are removed, even with access to the video and the remaining dialogue.
Considering a cooking video, an implicit reference alone does not ensure this: asking how much of ‘‘that ingredient’’ is used requires no dialogue history if the video contains only one ingredient. Such a question avoids revealing the ingredient’s identity but fails the necessity requirement.
blocks.zh:
Req-1:依赖性必要性。 一个依赖性问题在父母转身被移除时必须变得无法回答,即使可以访问视频和剩下的对话.
就烹饪视频而言,仅凭隐含的参考并不能保证这一点:如果视频只包含一种成分,那么询问该成分使用量有多少不需要对话历史。 这样的问题避免透露成分的身份,但未能满足必要性要求。

blocks.en:
Req-2: Dependency Non-leakage. A dependent question must not restate the episode descriptions or answers from its parents, even partially.
For example, if an earlier answer identifies ‘‘the flour in the red bowl’’ , asking ‘‘How much of the flour identified earlier is used?’’ partially reveals that answer.
If both a red and a blue bowl contain flour, the parent remains necessary to identify the target bowl.
Thus, a turn may satisfy necessity while violating non-leakage.
blocks.zh:
Req-2:依赖性无漏. 所依赖的问题不能重复插曲描述或父母的回答,甚至不能部分重复。
例如,如果一个早前的答案能识别出红碗中的"面粉",那么就问到前面确定的面粉中有多少被使用? —— 部分揭示了这一答案。
如果一面红碗和一面蓝碗都含有面粉,则父母仍有必要辨认出目标碗.
因此,在违反不漏水的情况下,转弯可能满足必要性。

blocks.en:
Req-3: Visual grounding. Every turn, whether dependent or not, must be anchored in a verifiable visual fact in the video.
For dependent turns, this evidence must support the answer under the interpretation established by the parent turns.
blocks.zh:
Req-3:视觉地面. 无论是否依附,每一转弯都必须以视频中可核实的视觉事实为依托.
对于依赖性转折,这种证据必须支持父母转折所确立的解释。

blocks.en: Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 建筑管道

blocks.en:
Guided by these requirements, we construct VideoMemBench through a pipeline combining three LLM roles with human expert review, as shown in Figure 2 .
A planner lays out the dependency structure of a dialogue before any question is written, providing the structural precondition for necessity (Req-1).
A generator realizes the plan turn by turn, referring to earlier turns only through referring expressions (Req-2) and anchoring every answer in frame evidence (Req-3).
A judger then verifies each generated turn against the three requirements and checks completed dialogues for consistency with the initial structural plan.
Human experts finally review each retained dialogue.
blocks.zh:
以这些要求为指导,我们通过一个管道构建了VideoMem Bench,将三种LLM作用与人类专家审查相结合,如图2所示。
计划者在提出任何问题之前就规定了对话的依赖结构,为必要性提供了结构上的先决条件(Req-1)。
生成器意识到计划会逐个转动,只通过转动表达式(Req-2)和将每个答案固定在帧证据(Req-3)中,来提及早先的转动.
然后,一名法官对照三项要求核查每个产生的转折,并检查已完成的对话是否符合最初的结构计划。
人类专家最后审查了每一方保留的对话。

blocks.en:
∙ \bullet Video Collection. We collect videos from multiple sources: Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , VSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025c ) , Video-MMMU ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and the web.
Web videos are sourced from YouTube across sports, talks and lectures, tutorials, film recaps, and cooking.
We also include EgoLife ( Yang et al., 2025d ) recordings, allowing recurring people and activities to support dependencies across distant moments.
This yields an initial pool of about 3.2k videos.
We then use a pre-trained LLM to annotate video domains and scene composition, guiding the selection of videos across different semantic domains with recurring entities and events suitable for cross-turn dependencies.
Further collection details are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
\bullet 视频收藏。 我们从多个来源收集视频:视频-MME(Fu等,2025年),VSI-Bench(Yang等,2025年c),视频-MMU (Hu等,2026). LongVideo Bench (Wu等,2024)并网.
网络视频来自YouTube, 包括体育、演讲、辅导、电影回顾和烹饪。
我们还包括了EgoLife(Yang等,2025d)的录音,允许人们和活动反复出现,支持遥远时刻的依赖。
这产生了大约3.2克视频的初步集合.
然后,我们使用一个预先训练的LLM来对视频域和场景组成进行注释,指导不同语义域的视频选择与反复出现的实体和适合倒转依赖的事件.
进一步的收集细节见附录A。

blocks.en:
∙ \bullet Turn-wise Generation. Following the plan, the generator constructs the dialogue turn by turn, densely sampling frames from each turn’s target segment.
For dependent turns, the segments are associated with their parents.
It first identifies a verifiable visual fact as the reference answer, then formulates a question according to the planned intent and dependency types. Dependent questions use referring expressions without restating the information supplied by their parents.
The supporting temporal interval is recorded as the answer’s evidence window.
blocks.zh:
* 回合制。 计划之后,生成器将对话逐个转弯,从每个转弯的目标部分取出密集的采样框。
对于依赖性转弯,各段与父母有关.
它首先将可核查的视觉事实确定为参考答案,然后根据计划的意图和依赖类型提出问题。 依赖性问题使用提法,而不重复父母提供的信息。
支持的时间间隔被记录为答案的证据窗口。

blocks.en:
∙ \bullet Turn-level Check. For dependent turns, the judger checks necessity by removing parent turns and rejecting questions that remain answerable from the video frames and remaining dialogue.
It checks non-leakage by comparing each question with its parents for restated episode descriptions or disclosed answers.
For every turn, it verifies that frames from the annotated evidence window support the reference answer and rejects questions that semantically duplicate earlier ones.
Rejected turns are regenerated using the judger’s feedback; two consecutive failures trigger replanning of the affected portion of the dialogue.
Our prompt templates for all stages are given in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
\bullet 转关检查。 对于依赖的转折,法官通过去掉父转折并拒绝从视频框中仍然可以回答的问题和剩余对话来检查必要性.
它通过将每个问题与父母进行比较来检查是否漏出,以便重述插曲描述或披露答案。
每转一圈,它都核实附加说明的证据窗口中的框架支持参考答案,并拒绝与先前问题重复的问题。
拒绝的回合会利用法官的反馈进行再生成;两次连续的失败会引发对话中受影响的部分的再规划.
我们所有阶段的快速模板见附录C。

blocks.en:
∙ \bullet Expert Review. Eight human experts review all dialogues that pass the automated checks against the corresponding videos.
Turns with incorrect answers, invalid dependencies, or information leakage are revised or removed, ensuring that every retained dialogue is human-reviewed.
Details of the dataset review and the separate human baseline evaluation are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
* 《专家评论》。 8名人类专家审查所有通过自动检查与相应视频对接的对话。
以错误的答案、无效的依赖性或信息渗漏进行修改或去除,以确保每个保留的对话都经过人审查。
数据集审查和单独的人类基线评价详情见附录D。

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 评价计量

blocks.en:
We use GPT-5.4 mini ( OpenAI, 2026d ) as the judge for open-ended responses and extract the predicted option for multiple-choice questions.
Each response is graded as correct or incorrect.
We report three metrics with distinct evaluation subsets and scoring rules, plus an aggregate score.
blocks.zh:
我们使用GPT-5.4迷你(OpenAI, 2026d)作为无限制响应的裁判,并提取多个选择问题的预测选项.
每一份答复都按正确或不正确分类。
我们报告三个衡量标准,有不同的评价子集和评分规则,加上一个总分。

blocks.en: Turn Accuracy (TurnAcc). TurnAcc measures accuracy over all turns. Each response is scored independently of whether the model answered its parent turns correctly.
blocks.zh: 转正等分(转正等分). TurnAcc测量所有转弯的精度. 每个响应的分数都独立于模型是否正确回答其母体转折.

blocks.en:
Episodic Dependency Accuracy (EpiDepAcc). EpiDepAcc measures accuracy over turns with at least one Episodic dependency. Each response is scored independently of its parents’ answer correctness, since an Episodic dependency refers to the visual context described by a parent question rather than the parent’s answer.
This metric measures recall of what the model has seen .

blocks.en: Benchmark Results
blocks.zh: 基准结果

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports results for 25 models, including 8 closed-source and 17 open-weight MLLMs.
Claude Opus 5 achieves the highest overall score of 45.7%, compared with 86.1% for human annotators.
This gap suggests substantial room for MLLMs to improve in-context video memory.
blocks.zh:
表2报告了25个模型的结果,包括8个封闭源代码和17个开放重量的MLLM。
克洛德·奥普斯(Claude Opus 5)的总得分最高,为45.7%,而人类的注释者则为86.1%.
这一空白表明,MLLMs有相当大的空间来改进内容中的视频内存。

blocks.en:
Claude Opus 5 leads the closed-source models across all three metrics, achieving 52.3% on TurnAcc, 49.1% on EpiDepAcc, and 35.7% on AnsDepAcc. Gemini 3.8 Flash and GPT-5.6-sol follow with overall scores of 42.4% and 41.7%, respectively, while GPT-5.4 scores lowest at 36.3%.
Across these closed-source models, AnsDepAcc is 16.6–22.9 percentage points below TurnAcc, compared with only 3.9 percentage points for human annotators.
Since AnsDepAcc requires correctness throughout the Answer-dependency ancestry, this gap reflects both current-turn errors and accumulated upstream failures.
These results highlight the difficulty of maintaining correct answers across dependent turns in extended video conversations, even for frontier models.
blocks.zh:
Claude Opus 5在全部三个度量衡中领先了闭源模型,在TurnAcc上达到52.3%,在EpiDepAcc上达到49.1%,在AnsDepAcc上达到35.7%. 双子座 3.8 Flash和GPT-5.6-sol跟随,总体分数分别为42.4%和41.7%,而GPT-5.4的分数最低为36.3%.

blocks.zh: 分析

blocks.en:
Dependency Distance. Figure 4 (a) groups dependent turns by the distance to their earliest parent.
Mean accuracy across all evaluated models decreases from 30.2% at distance 1 to 23.1% at distances of at least five turns, with a larger decline in the longest-distance group.
The model-specific trends differ: Gemini 3.8 Flash declines relatively steadily from 41.1% to 30.2%, whereas Qwen3.5-35B-A3B drops more sharply beyond distance 3, falling from 27.8% to 19.2%.
These trends suggest that longer dependencies pose greater challenges for in-context video memory, although models differ in their sensitivity to dependency distance.
blocks.zh:
依赖距离。 图4 (a) 受抚养群体按距离转至其最早的父母。
所有被评价模型的平均准确度从距离1的30.2%下降到距离至少5个转弯的23.1%,而距离最长的组群下降幅度较大。

这些趋势表明,较长的依赖性对内文视频内存构成更大的挑战,尽管模型对依赖距离的敏感性不同.

blocks.en:
Number of Parents. Figure 4 (b) shows a consistent decline in accuracy as the number of parent turns increases across all four models.
Kimi K3 remains the strongest at every parent count, but its accuracy falls from 40.8% with one parent to 29.8% with three.
GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.5-27B show the same trend, falling from 34.9% to 23.7% and from 30.1% to 17.3%, respectively.
These results suggest that integrating information from multiple earlier turns poses an additional challenge for in-context video memory, even for the strongest model in this comparison.

blocks.en:
Turn Position and Dependency. Table 3 shows that the mean of EpiDepAcc and AnsDepAcc is 13.1–17.3 percentage points below independent-turn accuracy across the five reported models, although this gap also reflects the stricter chain-crediting rule used by AnsDepAcc. Figure 4 (c) further compares independent and dependent turns at different dialogue positions.
For Gemini 3.8 Flash, dependent-turn accuracy decreases from 46.1% at turn 2 to 35.2% at turns 5 and beyond, while independent-turn accuracy declines more modestly, from 53.8% to 49.2%.
Qwen3.5-27B exhibits a similar pattern: dependent-turn accuracy falls from 36.2% to 28.1%, compared with a decline from 46.1% to 40.3% on independent turns.
Although independent-turn accuracy fluctuates at intermediate positions, dependent-turn accuracy declines consistently for both models.
These patterns suggest that later dialogue positions are associated with greater difficulty, particularly when answering requires information from earlier turns.

Effect of Answer History. Figure 4 (d) compares accuracy on answer-dependent turns under self-rollout and oracle histories, with independent-turn accuracy as a reference.
Oracle histories replace previous model responses with reference answers.
All three models benefit substantially: Qwen3-VL-8B improves from 12.3% to 32.4%, Qwen3-VL-32B from 17.2% to 37.3%, and Gemini 3.5 Flash from 29.7% to 47.2%.
These gains indicate that errors in earlier responses are an important source of difficulty for subsequent answer-dependent questions.
Nevertheless, oracle accuracy remains below independent-turn accuracy, suggesting that correct history alone is insufficient for reliable in-context video memory.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce VideoMemBench to evaluate video memory through explicit Episodic and Answer dependencies, distinguishing what a model has seen from what it has said, with automated verifications and human reviews.
Evaluation of over 20 MLLMs shows that the best model achieves only 45.7% overall, with lower accuracy on longer-range and multi-parent dependencies.
These findings highlight the difficulty of maintaining and using dialogue context in video conversations.
We hope VideoMemBench supports the development of video MLLMs that reliably recall and build on earlier observations and responses.
blocks.zh:
我们引入VideoMem Bench,通过明确的Episodic和Answer依赖性来评价视频内存,区分一个模型所看到的与它所说的话,以及自动化的验证和人文评论.
对20多个MLLMs的评价表明,最佳模型总体上只达到45.7%,对更远和多亲情依赖的精确度较低.
这些调查结果突出了在视频对话中保持和使用对话环境的困难。
我们希望VideoMem Bench支持开发可靠地回顾和借鉴先前观察和反应的MLLMs视频.

blocks.en: Appendix B Dependency Planning Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 规划细节

blocks.en: Before question generation, the planner examines keyframes sampled across the video and produces a complete dialogue specification. The plan contains four components:
blocks.zh: 在产生问题之前,规划师先检查整个视频中取样的键框,并制作完整的对话规格. 该计划包括四个部分:

blocks.en: The synopsis summarizes the main characters, events, and settings, providing the generator with global context for interpreting individual video segments.
blocks.zh: 概要总结了主角,事件和设置,为生成器提供了全局背景,用于解释单个视频段.

blocks.en: The planner identifies which parts of the video to cover, which capabilities to assess, and how many turns to construct. Target capabilities include entity recall, event continuation, and cross-scene character tracking.
blocks.zh: 规划者确定要覆盖的视频的哪些部分,评估哪些能力,以及要构建多少部分。 目标能力包括实体召回,事件续作和相机字符跟踪.

blocks.en: The planner constructs a directed acyclic graph whose nodes represent dialogue turns. Each dependent turn is assigned one or more earlier parent turns, with each incoming edge labeled as Episodic or Answer. Specifying the graph before generation allows dependencies to be coordinated across the dialogue.
blocks.zh: 规划者会构建一个直接的环行图,其节点代表对话的转折. 每个被依赖的转弯被指定一个或多个更早的父转弯,每个接入的边缘被标记为Episodic或Answer. 在生成前指定图表,可以在整个对话中协调依赖关系。

blocks.en: For each turn, the planner specifies what information it should establish and which video segment supports it. For dependent turns, the intent additionally identifies the information required from each parent, giving the generator an explicit basis for constructing the question.
blocks.zh: 每次转弯,规划者都具体说明它应建立哪些信息,以及哪个视频段支持它. 对于依附转弯,意向还另外指明了要求每个母体提供的信息,为生成者构建问题提供了明确的基础.

blocks.en: The plan must satisfy two constraints. First, dependencies must be motivated by recurring entities, events, or details in the video, rather than imposed between unrelated topics. Second, the selected segments must span the video rather than concentrate on a local clip. The complete plan is passed to the generator as the specification for turn-wise generation.
blocks.zh: 该计划必须满足两个制约因素。 首先,依赖性的动机必须是反复出现的实体,事件,或者视频中的细节,而不是在无关话题之间强加. 第二,选定的片段必须覆盖录像,而不是集中播放当地片段。 完整的计划被传递给发电机作为转动生成的规格.

blocks.en: Appendix C Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: 附录C 提示模板

blocks.en:
We report the prompt templates used to construct and evaluate VideoMemBench, following the pipeline in Figure 2 .
During initial video curation, a pre-trained LLM first assigns each collected video a semantic domain and scene tags.
In Stage 1, a Planner LLM watches each curated video and produces a dialogue-construction plan: a video introduction, a dialogue suggestion, the number of turns, a per-turn intent with its evidence window, and a typed dependency graph.
In Stages 2 and 3, a Generator LLM writes the dialogue turn by turn according to the plan, and a Judge LLM applies three turn-level checks (dependency necessity, non-leakage, and visual grounding); turns that fail are returned to the Generator LLM with the judge’s feedback for regeneration.
Each completed dialogue is then checked against the planner’s dependency graph (plan fidelity) and reviewed by human experts.
We preserve runtime placeholders such as {video_frames} , {plan} , and {parent_turns} .
In all prompts, an answer dependency means the child turn needs the parent turn’s correct answer, and an episodic dependency means the child turn only needs to relocate the same scene or entity as the parent turn.

blocks.en: ⬇ You are planning a multi - turn question - answering dialogue about one video for a benchmark that tests in - context video memory : later questions should only be answerable by remembering what earlier turns established . You will see frames sampled across the whole video , each preceded by a < MM : SS > time tag , and the video ’ s domain and scene list from the labeler . Do NOT write questions or answers . Produce a PLAN that another model will follow . (* @ \ textbf { Step 1: Video introduction } @ *) Write 2-4 sentences describing what happens in the video , in order , naming the main entities and scene changes . Only describe what is visible in the frames . (* @ \ textbf { Step 2: Dialogue suggestion } @ *) Decide how many turns the dialogue should have ( between { min_turns } and { max_turns }) and how it should move through the video . Pick at least three scene clusters that are far apart in time and describe the route : what is established first , what is revisited next , what is tracked last . List the memory abilities the dialogue will exercise , chosen from : entity recall , event continuation , clue - based reasoning , cross - scene tracking , spatial localization . (* @ \ textbf { Step 3: Intent for every turn } @ *) For each turn , give : - turn_id ( T1 , T2 , …) - question_type : multi_choice_question , true_or_false_question , or open_structured - dependency : independent , or a list of parent turns , each typed as " answer " or " episodic " - evidence window [ t_start , t_end ] in seconds where the answer is visible - intent : one sentence saying what the turn should establish or test (* @ \ textbf { Step 4: Dependency structure } @ *) Design the dependency graph with these rules : - " answer ": the child cannot be answered without the parent ’ s CORRECT answer . Test : if the parent were answered wrongly , would the child ’ s correct answer change ? Only then use " answer ". The parent of an " answer " edge may use any supported question type , provided that its answer supplies information required by the child . - " episodic ": the child only needs to return to the same scene , moment , or entity as the parent . The parent ’ s answer being wrong does not change the child ’ s answer . - Parents must come earlier than the child . The graph must have no cycles . - More than half of the turns must have at least one parent . - At least one turn must have two or three parents . - At least one edge must span two or more turns ( not only adjacent turns ). - T1 must be independent and may use any supported question type . - Evidence windows must cover the beginning , middle , and end of the video . - Every edge must be genuine : the child ’ s target must be hard to describe without the parent . Do not connect turns that are about unrelated things . Input : domain : { domain } scenes : { scenes } frames : { video_frames } Output ONLY JSON : { " video_intro ": string , " dialogue_suggestion ": { " num_turns ": int , " scene_route ": string , " abilities ": [ string , …] }, " turns ": [ {" turn_id ": " T1 ", " question_type ": string , " dependency ": " independent " | [{" parent ": " T #", " type ": " answer "|" episodic "}, …], " evidence ": {" t_start ": number , " t_end ": number }, " intent ": string } ], " dependency_graph ": [{" from ": " T #", " to ": " T #", " type ": " answer "|" episodic "}, …] }

T1必须是独立的,可以使用任何支持的问题类型。 每个边缘都必须是真实的:没有父母,孩子的目标必须很难描述。 不要连接关于无关事物的转折 。 输入:域:{域:}场景:{场景:{场景:{场景:}帧:{ 仅出JSON:{ "视频:Intro:弦","对话:建议":{ "num:turns","场景:路由:弦","能力:[弦,.]","转接:[{"转接:id: "T1","问题-类型:弦","依赖:"独立:"[{{}",类型:回答"|"缩写"}",.],"证据":"起":数字","结束:数字","意图:弦",",","依赖:从"[{"起":T","问题:":":":" "弦",""," "依赖:",","," "类型:",",",",",",",",","

blocks.en: ⬇ You are writing one turn of a multi - turn video QA dialogue , following a plan . You will see frames from the video with < MM : SS > time tags , the plan , and the turns already written . Write turn { turn_id } so that it matches its planned intent , question type , dependency , and evidence window exactly . (* @ \ textbf { Build the answer first } @ *) 1. Look at the frames inside the planned evidence window and pick ONE specific fact you can clearly see ( an identity , position , count , color , action , text , or change ). 2. That fact is the answer . If you cannot see a clear fact that serves the intent , say so in " plan_issue " instead of guessing . 3. Write a short question ( one sentence , at most two ) that asks for that fact . 4. For multiple choice , write 4 options ( A - D ) of the same kind , each under 15 words . Every wrong option should be plausible for this video and wrong for exactly one reason . 5. Write answer_reasoning : 1-2 sentences naming what in the frames makes the answer correct . (* @ \ textbf { Dependencies } @ *) - Refer to each parent turn inside the sentence by its turn id , for example " the player identified in T1 " or " the shelf asked about in T3 ". - For an " answer " parent , the question must be impossible to answer without knowing which option was correct in the parent . Refer to that result abstractly ; never state it . - For an " episodic " parent , the question returns to the same scene or entity . Give just enough visual anchors ( appearance , location , nearby landmark ) to find it again , but do not describe the parent ’ s scene so fully that the parent becomes unnecessary . - Never repeat a parent ’ s correct option , and never use words that make it obvious . The answering model will see earlier questions but not earlier correct answers . - Do not add dependencies that are not in the plan , and do not drop planned ones . (* @ \ textbf { Wording } @ *) - No exact timestamps in the question ; use scene descriptions (" when the scoreboard first appears "). - One question per turn . Natural language , no placeholders , no labels like " object A ". - true_or_false_question : options are exactly A = " Yes ", B = " No ". - open_structured : no options ; give a short reference answer and 1-3 acceptable paraphrases . Input : plan : { plan } turns written so far : { previous_turns } turn to write : { turn_plan } frames : { video_frames } Output ONLY JSON : { " turn_id ": " T #", " type ": " multi_choice_question "|" true_or_false_question "|" open_structured ", " dependency ": {" depends_on ": [" T #", …], " dep_type ": {" T #": " answer "|" episodic "}} | null , " question ": string , " options ": {" A ": string , " B ": string , " C ": string , " D ": string } | null , " answer ": string , " acceptable_answers ": [ string , …] | null , " answer_reasoning ": string , " evidence ": [{" t_start ": number , " t_end ": number }], " plan_issue ": string | null }
blocks.zh: ⬇ 您正在按照计划, 写一个多关节视频QA对话。 您可以在视频中看到带有 < MM: SS > 时间标记的帧、 计划和已经写好的转折 。 写入 { turn_ id } 使其与计划的意图、 问题类型、 依赖性、 证据窗口完全一致 。 (@\ textbf { ) (% ) 建立答案 } @ *) 1. 查看计划证据窗口内的框架,并选择一个具体的事实,你可以清楚地看到(身份、位置、数、颜色、动作、文字或变化)。 2. 事实就是答案。 如果您看不出一个符合意图的明确事实,请在 " plan_issues " 而不是猜测中这样说。 3. 写出一个简短的问题(一句话,最多两句),要求了解这一事实。 4. 对于多种选择,请写出同一种的4个选项(A-D)。 任何错误的选择都应该是可信的, 5. 写出答案_解释: 1-2句点出框中哪些内容使答案正确。 (@\ textbf { dependenies } @ *) - 指每个父母在句子内按其转动的 id 转动,例如 " T1 中识别的玩家 " 或 " T3 中询问的架子 " 。 - 对于 " 答案 " 的家长来说,在不知道父母哪一个选项正确的情况下,这个问题是不可能回答的。 抽象地提及这一结果;永远不要说明。 但不要完全描述家长的场景, - 永远不要重复父母的正确选择,也不要用言语说明这一点。 答案模式会看到更早的问题,但不会看到更早的正确答案。 - 不要增加计划中没有的依赖性,不要放弃计划中的依赖性。 ( * @\ textbf { wording} @ *) - 问题中没有确切的时间戳;使用场景描述("当记分牌首次出现时"). - 每个转弯一个问题. 自然语言,没有占位符,没有 " 对象A " 等标签。 - true_或_false_ question:选项完全为A = " 是 " ,B = " 否 " 。 - 打开_结构化:没有选项;给出一个简短的参考答案和1-3可接受参数。 输入 : 计划 : {计划 } 已写至今 : {上个_turns} 已写 : {turn_plan} 帧 : { video_frames}只输出 JSON: { "turn-id": "T#","类型": "Multi_ choice_ question" "|" true_"或_false_ question "|" "|" 开_结构","依赖": {"依附" 依附": [""#",".","去p-型" "{" :"去p-" T" "只输出 JSON" : { answer" "|" "}}" " question" ,"问"取出"弦","取出弦";"取弦";"取弦";"取出弦";";"取出弦";";"回答" [ string";" 取出弦;" "取出弦" ";" "取出" :" "取出"

blocks.en: ⬇ A turn you wrote was rejected by a quality check . Rewrite it so it passes , keeping everything the plan requires . You will see the plan entry for this turn , the turns written so far , the rejected turn , the name of the failed check , and the judge ’ s reason . (* @ \ textbf { How to fix each failed check } @ *) - dependency_necessity : the turn could be answered without its parent ( s ). Remove the details that let the target be found on its own , and refer to the parent turn instead , so that the parent is genuinely required . - non_leakage : the question re - described the parent ’ s episode or revealed the parent ’ s answer . Replace those words with a neutral reference to the parent turn by its turn id . - visual_grounding : the frames in the evidence window do not support the answer . Pick a fact that IS visible in that window and rebuild the question and answer around it . (* @ \ textbf { Keep fixed } @ *): turn_id , question type , planned dependency and its types , evidence window . If the turn cannot be fixed without changing the plan , return the turn unchanged and explain in " plan_issue ". Input : plan entry : { turn_plan } turns written so far : { previous_turns } rejected turn : { turn } failed check : { check_name } judge reason : { judge_reason } frames : { video_frames } Output ONLY JSON with the same schema as Turn Generation .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 你写的转弯被质量检查拒绝了 重写它,所以它通过, 保持计划需要的一切。 你会看到这个回合的计划条目, 至今为止的回合, 被拒绝的回合, 失败的检查名称, 如何修复每个失败的检查 } @ * —— 依赖性_ 必要性 : 转弯可以没有它的母( s) 来回答 。 移除让目标自己找到的细节, 转而引用父回合, 这样父母才是真正需要的 。 - 非漏出:问题再次涉及父母的一集或透露父母的答案。 以中性地取而代之的是 " 父母转身 " 。 - 视觉_地平线 : 证据窗口中的帧不支持答案 。 选择一个在窗口中可见的 IS 的事实, 并重建问答 。 (* @\ textbf { 保持固定 } @ *: turn_id, 问题类型, 计划依赖性及其类型, 证据窗口 。 如果转弯不能不改变计划,则回转方向不变,并在 " plan_issue " 中解释。 输入 : 计划条目 : {turn_plan} 已写入至今的回合 : {上个_turns} 已拒绝的回合 : {turn} 失败的检查 : { 检查_名称}判断理由 : { 判断_ 解释} 帧 : { 视频_ 帧 } 输出 JSON 与 Turn Generation 相同的方案 。

blocks.en: ⬇ You are answering one question about a video . Some earlier turns of the conversation have been removed on purpose . Answer only if the frames and the remaining conversation are enough . You will see frames from the video with < MM : SS > time tags , the conversation so far with some turns removed , and one question . (* @ \ textbf { Rules } @ *): - If the question refers to an earlier turn that is not shown , you do not know what that turn established . Do not guess what it said . - If you can still identify the answer with confidence from the frames alone , give it . - If the answer depends on information you do not have , output " ABSTAIN ". Input : frames : { video_frames } conversation ( parent turns removed ): { history_without_parents } question : { question } options : { options } Output ONLY JSON : {" answer ": string , " confidence ": number , " why ": string } // answer : an option letter , a short answer for open questions , or " ABSTAIN " Decision rule ( applied by the pipeline , not shown to the probe ): the turn is REJECTED if the probe answers correctly with confidence >= 0.5, because then the memory chain was decorative .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 你在回答一个关于视频的问题。 更早的谈话被故意删除。 只有在框架和剩余对话足够时才能回答。 您将会看到视频中带有 < MM: SS > 时间标记的帧, 到目前为止与一些转弯的对话被删除, 以及一个问题 。 (@\ textbf { rules } @ *): - 如果问题指的是一个没有显示的更早转弯,你不知道那个转弯是什么确定的 。 不要猜它说什么。 如果你仍然能从框架中自信地识别答案,就给答案。 如果答案取决于您没有的信息,请输出 " ABSPAIN " 。 输入 : 帧 : { video_frames}} 对话( 父回合已删除 ): {历史_没有_家长} 问题 : {问题} 选项 : { 选项} Out Only JSON : {" 回答":字符串","信任","数字", "为什么":字符串 } // 回答:一个选项字母,一个对未决问题的简短回答,或 " ABSSAIN " 决定规则(由管道应用,未向探测器显示) : 如果探测器有自信地正确回答的话 转弯就是重听 0.5,因为那时记忆链是装饰性的.

blocks.en: ⬇ You are checking whether a later question gives away its parent turns . You will see the later question next to each of its parent turns ( question , options , and correct answer ). You do not see the video . A question LEAKS if either condition holds : 1. Answer leak : it states , paraphrases , or reveals any part of a parent ’ s correct answer , even if the parent is still needed to recover the remaining information . 2. Episode re - description : it repeats identifying details of the scene , moment , or entity established by an episodic parent , rather than referring to it without restating those details . Generic references such as " the player identified in T1 " or " the moment discussed in T3 " are allowed . For example , if a parent answer is " the flour in the red bowl ", " How much of the flour identified earlier is used ?" leaks the ingredient , even if the parent is still needed to identify the bowl . Leakage does not require making the parent unnecessary . Input : later question : { question } dependency types : { dep_type } parent turns : { parent_turns } Output ONLY JSON : { " leak ": true | false , " answer_leak_parents ": [" T #", …], " redescribed_parents ": [" T #", …], " offending_text ": [ string , …], " reason ": string }
blocks.zh: ⬇ 您正在检查以后的问题是否会让父母知道 您将看到每个父回合旁边的后一问题(问题、选项和正确答案)。 你没看到视频。 一个问题LEAKS 如果其中任何一个条件都: 1. 答漏:它说明、解释或揭示父母正确回答的任何部分,即使父母仍需要收回所余信息。 2. Episode re -- description :它重复识别场景、瞬间或由偶发父母建立的实体的细节,而不是在不重复这些细节的情况下提及这些细节。 允许使用 " T1 中识别的玩家 " 或 " T3 中讨论的时刻 " 等一般参考。 例如,如果父母的回答是 " 红碗中的面粉 " , " 前面确定的面粉用多少? " ,则会漏出成分,即使父母仍然需要识别碗。 渗漏并不要求父母不必要。 输入 : 后题 : {问题} 依赖类型 : { dep_type} 父转: { sparent_turns } 输出只 JSON : { "泄露": 真实的 {} 虚假的 , "回答_leak_parents " : ["T #",.], "重新描述的_parents ": ["T #",.], "违法的_文本": [字符串,.], "原因": 字符串]

blocks.en: ⬇ You are checking whether a question and its reference answer are supported by the video . You will see ONLY the frames from the turn ’ s annotated evidence window , each with a < MM : SS > tag , and the question - answer pair . (* @ \ textbf { Steps } @ *): 1. Before reading the reference answer , answer the question yourself from these frames . 2. Compare your answer with the reference answer . 3. Check that the question itself contains no facts that contradict the frames ( wrong numbers , text , colors , or objects ). 4. For multiple choice , check that exactly one option is correct in these frames . The turn is SUPPORTED only if the frames clearly show the fact the reference answer states and no other option is also correct . If the key object or action is not visible in these frames , it is NOT supported , even if you believe it happens elsewhere in the video . Input : frames ( evidence window ): { evidence_frames } question : { question } options : { options } reference answer : { answer } Output ONLY JSON : { " supported ": true | false , " my_answer ": string , " support_ts ": [ string , …], // < MM : SS > tags of frames showing the fact " question_factual_errors ": [ string , …], " multiple_correct_options ": true | false , " reason ": string }
blocks.zh: ⬇ 您正在检查一个问题及其参考答案是否得到视频的支持 。 您将只看到转弯时附加说明的证据窗口中的帧, 每个窗口都有一个 < MM: SS > 标记, 以及问题 - 答对 。 (* @\ textbf{ steps} @ *) : 1. 在阅读参考答复之前,请从这些框架回答问题。 2. 将你的回答与参考答案进行比较。 3. 请检查问题本身是否包含任何与框架相矛盾的事实(错误的数字、文字、颜色或对象)。 4. 对于多种选择,请检查这些框架是否准确正确。 只有在框架明确显示参考答案时, 如果关键对象或动作在这些框中不可见, 它不支持, 即使你相信它发生在视频的其他地方。 输入:框架(证据窗口): {evidence_frames} 问题 : { question} 选项 : { 选项} 参考回答 : { 仅提供 JSON : { " 支持 " : 真实 { 虚假 : " my_ answer " : 字符串, " 支持-ts " : [字符串,.], // < MM: SS > 标记的框架显示事实 " 问题-事实-错误-错误 " : [字符串,.], " 多重_正确_选项 " : 真实 ; " 理由 " :字符串]

blocks.en: ⬇ You are checking whether a finished dialogue was built the way it was planned . You will see the planner ’ s per - turn intents and dependency graph , and the completed dialogue . You do not see the video . For every turn , read the question and decide which earlier turns it actually needs , and for each one whether it needs the parent ’ s correct ANSWER or only the same scene or entity ( EPISODIC ). Base this on the question text , not on the dependency fields the generator wrote . Then compare this realized graph with the planned graph : - missing edge : planned but the question does not actually need that parent - extra edge : the question needs a parent that the plan did not include - retyped edge : planned as " answer " but only episodic is needed , or the reverse Also flag any turn whose question does not serve its planned intent . The dialogue is REJECTED if any edge is missing , extra , or retyped , or if any turn does not serve its intent . blocks.en: Appendix D Human Review Details

blocks.en: Dataset Review
blocks.zh: 数据集审查

blocks.en: We conduct a human review of all constructed multi-turn dialogues and dependency annotations before finalizing VideoMemBench. Eight experts participate in this review. As shown in Figure 5 , our web interface presents the video alongside the dialogue in turn order. Each turn displays its question, reference answer, supporting timestamps, question type, and dependency links to earlier turns.
blocks.zh: 我们在最后确定视频Mem Bench之前,对所有构建的多回合对话和依赖性说明进行人文审查。 8名专家参加了这次审查。 如图5所示,我们的网络界面按顺序将视频与对话并列。 每个转弯会显示它的问题,参考答案,支持时间戳,问题类型,以及先前转弯的依赖性链接.

blocks.en: Human Baseline Evaluation
blocks.zh: 人类基线评价

blocks.en:
The human baseline in Table 2 is evaluated separately from dataset review, using the same web interface configured for evaluation.
In this mode, annotators see only the inputs available to models, with reference answers, evidence annotations, and dependency labels hidden.
Twenty annotators evaluate all 326 dialogues, with each dialogue assigned to two annotators who answer independently.
This yields 652 complete dialogue evaluations: 12 annotators each evaluate 33 dialogues, and the remaining eight each evaluate 32.
Assignments are balanced across video categories, dialogue lengths, and dependency complexity.
Where possible, annotators are assigned dialogues they did not previously review.
blocks.zh:
表2中的人类基线与数据集审查分开评价,使用为评价配置的同一网页界面。
在这种模式下,注释者只看到模型可用的输入,并隐藏了参考答案,证据说明和依赖性标签.
20名注释员评估所有326个对话,每次对话都分配给两个独立回答的注释员.
这样可产生652个完整的对话评价:12个注释员每个评价33个对话,其余8个评价32个。
任务在视频类别、对话框长度和依赖性复杂性之间是平衡的。
在可能的情况下,指定了注释员对话,他们以前没有审查过。

blocks.en: Evaluation inputs. Annotators receive the same 128 timestamped frames as the models, without access to the full video, reference answers, annotated evidence intervals, or dependency labels. Questions and answer options, where applicable, are presented sequentially. Each annotator can access the preceding questions and their own previous responses, but not the other annotator’s answers. Dialogues are evaluated in full rather than divided among annotators, preserving a separate response history for each evaluation.
blocks.zh: 评价投入。 注释者得到与模型相同的128倍印帧,无法访问完整视频,参考答案,注释证据间隔,或依赖性标签. 在适用的情况下,问答选项按顺序列出。 每个注释者可以查阅前面的问题和他们自己以前的答复,但不能查阅其他注释者的答复。 对对话进行全面评价,而不是在注释者之间进行划分,为每次评价保留单独的回复历史。

blocks.en: Scoring and aggregation. Human responses are graded using the same correctness criteria as model responses. TurnAcc, EpiDepAcc, and AnsDepAcc follow the definitions in subsection 4.2 . For AnsDepAcc, chain credit is computed separately within each annotator’s dialogue: a turn receives credit only if the current response and all of its Answer-dependency ancestors are correct. Scores are then aggregated across both evaluations of every dialogue, with equal weight given to each evaluation. Responses from different annotators are not combined through majority voting. Overall is the arithmetic mean of the three aggregated metrics.
blocks.zh: 分分分相并相会. 人类反应采用与模型反应相同的正确性标准进行分级. TurnAcc、EpiDepAcc和AnsDepAcc遵循第4.2分节中的定义。 对AnsDepAcc来说,链式信用在每一个注释者的对话中分别计算:只有当当前的反应及其所有答案-依赖性祖先正确时,链式信用才能获得。 然后,在每次对话的两次评价中汇总得分,对每次评价给予同等重视。 不同注释者的答复不通过多数表决合并。 总体而言,是三个总指标的算术平均值。

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Results and Examples
blocks.zh: 附录E 其他结果和实例

blocks.en: Effect of Frame Count
blocks.zh: 框架计数的效果

blocks.en: We evaluate 13 open-weight models with 16, 32, and 64 uniformly sampled frames per video under the same self-rollout protocol and scoring rules as the main experiments. Table 4 reports the results, complementing the 128-frame evaluation in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价13个开放量级模型,每个视频有16个,32个和64个统一抽样的帧,按照与主要实验相同的自行推出协议和评分规则. 表4报告了结果,补充了表2中的128框架评价。

blocks.en: Performance across frame budgets. Increasing the number of frames generally improves performance. All 13 models achieve higher Overall scores with 64 frames than with 16 frames. Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B ranks first at all three frame budgets, improving from 25.9% to 29.5% and 31.7% with 16, 32, and 64 frames, respectively. Its score rises further to 34.4% with 128 frames. Qwen3.5-27B similarly improves from 25.3% at 16 frames to 29.8% at 64 frames and 34.3% at 128 frames. These results suggest that denser temporal sampling provides useful visual evidence for answering questions throughout the dialogue.
blocks.zh: 跨框架预算的执行情况。 增加帧数一般会提高性能. 所有13个型号都取得了64个帧比16个帧更高的总分. Quen3-VL-235B-A22B号 在所有三个框架预算中排名第一,分别从25.9%提高到29.5%和31.7%,分别为16个、32个和64个框架。 其分数以128帧进一步上升到34.4%. Quen3.5-27B同样从16帧的25.3%提高到64帧的29.8%和128帧的34.3%. 这些结果表明,更密集的时间取样为在整个对话中回答问题提供了有用的视觉证据。

blocks.en: Variation across models. The gains from additional frames vary considerably. From 16 to 64 frames, Qwen3-VL-32B improves by 6.2 percentage points overall, compared with 2.1 points for Keye-VL-1.5-8B. Increasing the frame budget from 32 to 64 improves Overall for 12 of the 13 models, with Qwen2.5-VL-3B showing a slight decrease from 16.9% to 16.7%. Qwen3.5-0.8B gains only 0.1 percentage points over the same interval. Thus, additional visual input generally benefits performance, but does not yield uniform gains across models.
blocks.zh: 跨模型变化。 额外框架的收益相去甚远。 从16到64帧,Qwen3-VL-32B整体改善6.2个百分点,而Keye-VL-1.5-8B则为2.1分. 将框架预算从32个增加到64个 总体而言,13个型号中有12个型号,Quen2.5-VL-3B型号略有下降,从16.9%降至16.7%。 Quen3.5-0.8B在同一间隔时间内只增加0.1个百分点. 因此,额外的视觉输入一般有利于业绩,但不能产生不同模型的统一收益。

blocks.en: Answer-dependent performance. AnsDepAcc remains below both TurnAcc and EpiDepAcc for every model at every frame budget in this ablation. For Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B, increasing the frame count from 16 to 64 raises AnsDepAcc from 11.7% to 15.6%, while Qwen3.5-27B improves from 8.2% to 14.8%. With 128 frames, their AnsDepAcc scores increase further to 18.6% and 20.9%, respectively. These gains show that additional visual evidence can improve correctness across answer-dependent chains, although the metric remains sensitive to both current-turn errors and upstream failures.
blocks.zh: 答相依性能. AnsDepAcc在这一减法中每个框架预算的每个模型都低于TurnAcc和EpiDepAcc。 对于Quen3-VL-235B-A22B,将帧数从16个增加到64个将AnsDepAcc从11.7%提高到15.6%,而Quen3.5-27B则从8.2%提高到14.8%. 以128帧,他们的AnsDepAcc分数分别进一步提高到18.6%和20.9%. 这些成果表明,额外的可视证据可以改善所有依赖答案的链条的正确性,尽管衡量标准仍然对当前转弯出错和上游出错都很敏感。
